scientific.integrity: The exact state orbit is obtained by solving the source NovoGrad recurrence on an eigenvector. Orthogonality makes the layerwise second-moment perturbation vanish to first order in transverse eigenmodes, producing an explicit constant two-dimensional Floquet block and a sharp Jury stability test.
limitations: The theorem classifies orthogonal transverse modes, not radial stability of the cycle.
Weight decay, the optional gradient-averaging variant, stochastic gradients, and learning-rate schedules are excluded.
The epsilon floor affects cycle existence although it cancels from the transverse polynomial.
The exact orbit need not coincide with the source initialization trajectory.
